info.title: Xasha API
info.description: Account-free, one-time encrypted text sharing. Never send plaintext or encryption keys. Never automatically retry consumption. Public secret routes allow any browser origin without credentials. Opening a client share page must not consume a secret.

tags.name: Secrets
tags.description: Create, retrieve once, and privately delete encrypted text.

DeleteToken.description: Private deletion credential, sent only in the JSON body.

Envelope.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext with appended 128-bit tag; fresh 12-byte IV. No plaintext or encryption key.

post.description: Encrypt locally. Send only the envelope and expiry; never send plaintext or keys. Creation is not idempotent.
